scope: Independent numerical audit from recorded native coefficients; imports neither adapter nor MPPI implementation
message_hash_limitation: Coefficient JSON omits full ROS serialized fields including header.seq and exact secs/nsecs; byte hashes were not independently reconstructed.
reference_hash_semantics: SHA256 over little-endian float64 rows [relative_time,x,y,yaw,signed_speed,q1..q6]; absolute source_stamp is separate. Hash identifies received sampled content, not a time-varying per-solve H-step reference.
limitations: Base MPPI follows geometric reference progress; arm reference follows original wall-clock phase. Unified whole-body phase tracking is not established.
Native protocol lacks goal_id and atomic bundle length; timestamps and quiet interval do not prove goal ownership or complete delivery.
No hardware actuation or safety certification; native_coefficients are a numerical input audit only.
archive_note: Lossless gzip after numerical audit; decoded content unchanged.
